environment.description: Terraform provider runs inside a Kubernetes pod in a cluster where namespace 'ci-runners' has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (PSA restricted profile). The cluster also retains a legacy PodSecurityPolicy object 'psp-ci-restricted' (still evaluated by the in-tree admission controller on this 1.24 cluster where the feature gate PodSecurity is enabled alongside PSP for dual-enforcement during migration). The PSP specifies: privileged=false, allowedHostPaths=[] (empty, blocking all hostPath), runAsUser=MustRunAsNonRoot, volumes=[configMap,emptyDir,projected,secret,persistentVolumeClaim]. The restricted PSA profile independently rejects any pod spec with hostPath volumes or privileged=true or runAsUser=0. The runner pod uses an emptyDir for /tmp (pod-local, not shared with host).
